newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends stable at 1,590-1,600 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends stable at 1,590-1,600 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed at 1,590-1,600 per dollar on Thursday, unchanged from the morning and the previous close, dealers said.
"Most banks and final clients sold dollars between 1,590-1,600 levs mainly to the central bank and traded volumes were relatively high," said a bank dealer.
Central bank officials were not available for comment.
Traders said that commercial banks and clients bought levs for dollars to meet tax and wage payments due end-month and end-quarter.
Banks also switched to lev positions to profit on high-yield lev deposits during upcoming Easter holidays in Western Europe and in the U.S. in anticipation of ongoing lev stability.
"Interest rates on lev-denominated investments provide a higher yield now that the lev is stable," another dealer said.

The central bank's main interest rate is now set at 18 percent monthly or 216 percent annually, based on the effective yield of one- and four-week discount T-bills issued daily by the Finance ministry.
